# bash32_empty_array_baseline.txt — committed baseline for #410.
# Each line is an existing UNGUARDED bare "${ARR[@]}"/"${ARR[*]}"
# expansion of an empty-initialized array in framework/scripts, as a
# stable (relpath<TAB>ARRAY<TAB>sym) key. These are the currently-present
# candidates (triaged as existing, mostly non-empty-by-construction or
# pre-existing). The ratchet fails on any NET-NEW key — including an
# idiom->bare regression of a currently-safe array (e.g. NIX_BUILD_FLAGS).
# Regenerate after an intentional change with:
#   python3 tests/lib/bash32_empty_array_scan.py framework/scripts \
#     > /tmp/scan && (grep '^#' tests/fixtures/bash32_empty_array_baseline.txt; cat /tmp/scan) \
#     > tests/fixtures/bash32_empty_array_baseline.txt
